source_policy: Curated team-process summaries only. No full private-channel history, client records, billing, credentials, or personal vault content. Linked files and recordings are resource locators unless explicitly summarized.

resources.title: Account Manager Master Hub
resources.text: Start in #accountmanagement and open the Account Manager Master Hub tab. It organizes AM training, new-client onboarding, communication sequences, task management, reporting, and tool options. The same channel also has Welcome guide, Onboarding to-dos, and AM to-dos tabs. Ask Melissa Silber about missing process or training material.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.

resources.title: Client onboarding: first two weeks
resources.text: The Master Hub's onboarding sequence covers the first two weeks: audit and strategy, a strategy document and presentation, mapping next steps, and weekly check-ins. Use the new-client onboarding template as the starting point; fill in the actual client, owner, scope, and dates.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.

resources.title: Client strategy document example
resources.text: The Master Hub links a strategy document example for planning a new client's audit, strategy, and next steps. This is an example to adapt to the verified client scope, not evidence that a strategy has been approved.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.

resources.title: Strategy presentation template
resources.text: Use the strategy presentation template linked in the Master Hub when preparing a new-client strategy presentation. Confirm the client facts and scope before presenting it.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.

resources.title: Monday internal plan and Slack update
resources.text: Each Monday, fill out: completed last week, priorities for this week, unresolved issues with action plans, and important deadlines. Add the team's priorities to the client canvas or project tracker. Melissa or the team sets up the Monday internal Slack automation.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.

resources.title: Monday client email or text check-in
resources.text: The Master Hub requires a Monday client check-in by email or text. Include completed work, this week's plan, review items, deadlines, and verified highlights or metrics. This assistant can draft the update; the responsible account manager reviews and sends it.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.

resources.title: Friday client wrap-up
resources.text: On Fridays, send the client a progress update and follow up on review items and outstanding items. The reviewed Master Hub's Friday email template stops after the greeting, so no complete approved Friday template is available in this source.
resources.coverage: Reviewed summary; linked assets retain their existing access permissions.
